challenge.results: The words and punctuation correspond. The mirror uses TeX comment prefixes and wraps the first line after “processing,” while SPDX wraps it after the second “when.” The tag object, its target commit, the Automake v1.16.5 citation, and the macro version 2021-04-25.21 each identify a different aspect of the evidence.

limitations: The comparison establishes documentary correspondence in release 3.29.0. Byte equality and formal SPDX template matching are outside scope.

The Savannah URL establishes what SPDX cited. Its tagged file was not separately acquired or compared byte for byte. The citation supplies no independent evidence of first publication or GNU Texinfo upstream lineage.
